options.name: allowTxtBlockingReport
options.description: Include TXT blocking report for TXT queries.

options.name: api_port
options.description: Port for the Technitium DNS API. Defaults to 5380

options.name: api_token
options.description: API token for authenticating with the Technitium DNS API

options.name: api_url
options.description: Base URL for the Technitium DNS API

options.name: blockListUpdateIntervalHours
options.description: Interval in hours to update block lists.

options.name: blockListUrls
options.description: Block list URLs. Use clear_blockListUrls to remove all block list URLs.

options.name: blockingAnswerTtl
options.description: TTL in seconds for blocking responses.

options.name: blockingBypassList
options.description: Networks allowed to bypass blocking.

options.name: blockingType
options.description: Response type for blocked domains.

options.name: cacheFailureRecordTtl
options.description: Failure TTL value for caching ServerFailure responses.

options.name: cacheMaximumEntries
options.description: Maximum cache entries.

options.name: cacheMaximumRecordTtl
options.description: Maximum TTL allowed in cache.

options.name: cacheMinimumRecordTtl
options.description: Minimum TTL allowed in cache.

options.name: cacheNegativeRecordTtl
options.description: Negative TTL value.

options.name: cachePrefetchEligibility
options.description: Minimum initial TTL to be eligible for prefetching.

options.name: cachePrefetchSampleEligibilityHitsPerHour
options.description: Minimum hits per hour to be eligible for auto prefetch.

options.name: cachePrefetchSampleIntervalInMinutes
options.description: Interval to sample eligible domains for auto prefetch.

options.name: cachePrefetchTrigger
options.description: TTL trigger to start prefetch; 0 disables.

options.name: clear_blockListUrls
options.description: Clear all block list URLs. Cannot be used together with blockListUrls.

options.name: clear_forwarders
options.description: Clear all forwarders to use recursion. Cannot be used together with forwarders.

options.name: clear_qpmPrefixLimitsIPv4
options.description: Clear all IPv4 prefix limits. Cannot be used together with qpmPrefixLimitsIPv4.

options.name: clear_qpmPrefixLimitsIPv6
options.description: Clear all IPv6 prefix limits. Cannot be used together with qpmPrefixLimitsIPv6.

options.name: clear_recursionNetworkACL
options.description: Clear recursion network ACL entries. Cannot be used together with recursionNetworkACL.

options.name: clear_tsigKeys
options.description: Clear all TSIG keys. Cannot be used together with tsigKeys.

options.name: clientTimeout
options.description: Time in ms before responding ServerFailure when no answer (1000-10000).

options.description: Query multiple forwarders concurrently.

options.name: customBlockingAddresses
options.description: Custom addresses returned when blockingType is CustomAddress.

options.name: defaultRecordTtl
options.description: Default TTL value for records when not specified.

options.description: Default SOA Responsible Person email for new primary zones.

options.description: Accept DNS-over-TLS requests.

options.description: Accept DNS-over-UDP-PROXY requests.

options.description: Store only last hour stats in memory (no disk stats).

options.description: Number of forwarder retries.

options.name: maxConcurrentResolutionsPerCore

options.name: resolverConcurrency

options.name: resolverMaxStackCount

options.description: Number of resolver retries.

options.name: resolverTimeout
options.description: Resolver timeout in ms.

options.name: reverseProxyNetworkACL
options.description: ACL for reverse proxy sources.

options.description: Save DNS cache on disk at shutdown.

options.description: Serve stale records when upstream unavailable.
